name: polynomial_resultant.py
mathematical_scope: Evaluates polynomially cleared Uhat/Lhat and the selected 9x9 gate minor. The algebraic identity Uhat=h0*U and Lhat=(z-1)T*L holds on the regular chart.
input_and_guard_coverage: No explicit prime/primitive-eighth-root or h-length validator; z inverse required. run_checks skips h0=0, Delta=0 and T=0, so exceptional branches are intentionally untested.
costs: Fixed-size (8,11x9) algebra per evaluation; n random samples, field inverse costs, and imported sparse evaluations. No general-N algorithm.
test_evidence: Three prime fields, fixed seeds, minimum half of random samples regular, two specific mod17 minor expectations.
acceptance_boundary: Sampled scaling agreement is regression evidence; integral identity follows the displayed algebra under dependency definitions. Regular-chart gate only.
findings: L61 deliberately skips exceptional parameters. L67 count threshold can be vacuous for small/nonpositive n; default n=100 is meaningful.
